content: व्यवस्था €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To be placed asunder. .²2 To be arranged in due order. .²3 To be settled or fixed, become permanent; वचनीयमिदं व्यवस्थितम् <ls>Ku. 4. 21</ls>; नटवद् व्यवतिष्ठते लिङ्गम् <ls>Sāṅ. K. 42</ls>. .²4 To rest or depend upon. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To place or rest upon, direct towards; तयोः समापत्तिषु कातराणि किंचिद्व्यवस्थापितसंहृतानि <ls>Ku. 7. 75</ls>. .²2 To arrange, manage, adjust. .²3 To settle, resolve, decree. .²4 To separate, place apart. .²5 To do, perform. .²6 To lay down a rule or law, enact a law.

व्यवस्था .²1 Adjustment, arrangement, settlement; as in वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्था. .²2 Fixity, definiteness; भङ्गं जयं चापतुरव्यवस्थम् <ls>R. 7. 54</ls>. .²3 Fixity, firm basis; आजह्रतुस्तच्चरणौ पृथिव्यां स्थलारविन्दश्रियमव्यवस्थाम् <ls>Ku. 1. 33</ls>. .²4 Relative position. .²5 A settled rule, law, statute, decree, decision, legal opinion, written declaration of the law (especially on doubtful points or where contradictory texts have to be properly adjusted). .²6 An agreement, a contract. .²7 State, condition. .²8 State or order of things. .²9 Separation.
